criteria.text: Is the agent's stated reasoning consistent with the edits it actually made and the feedback it received (no post-hoc rationalization, no lucky guess)?
Did each refinement stage (lint, test) do real, feedback-responsive work toward the solution rather than cosmetic or no-op changes?

Stopping an actor terminates its children first and waits for their termination before running the actor's own post_stop and removing it from its parent's child set (leaf-first ordering), rather than terminating an actor while its children are still active.
Strategy::Escalate propagates the failure to the parent's supervisor and applies the parent's strategy (not re-applying the child's strategy at the same level).
